rules.content:
/*
d4rk4rmy ransomware
*/

rule d4rk4rmy_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.d4rk4rmy"
        description = "Detects d4rk4rmy ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "d4rk4rmy" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "D4RK4RMY" ascii
        $onion  = "d4rk4rmy.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
